TRAINING FAQ

Before arranging a course,
you might want to ask:

Is a technical background required?＋

No. Management courses focus on judgment and organization, while business courses start from real workflows; suitable tools and templates will be provided when technical practice is involved.

Online or offline?＋

Both are possible. We recommend in-person for management co-creation and deep scenario workshops, while knowledge explanation and post-course tutoring can be done online.

Can enterprise real data be used?＋

Yes, but we will first confirm the data boundaries and de-sensitization requirements. Sensitive materials will not directly enter unapproved third-party tools.

Can it continue to be implemented after training?＋

Yes. Priority scenarios can directly enter the FDE co-creation pilot, avoiding a situation where only courseware remains after training.
